title: Common length of maximal prime chains
statement: For a field k and a finite type k-algebra domain S, there is d : ℕ with ringKrullDim S = (d : WithBot ℕ∞), and every maximal prime LTSeries in S has length d.

proof.text: Use a polynomial presentation of S and the height-difference theorem for saturated chains between the kernel prime and maximal ideals; all such chains have the same length, which equals ringKrullDim S.

lean.statement: theorem finiteTypeDomain_ringKrullDim_localizationAtMaximal_chains {k : Type u} [Field k] {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Algebra.FiniteType k S] [IsDomain S] : ∃ (d : ℕ), ringKrullDim S = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ ∀ (p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S)), IsMaxChain (fun q r : PrimeSpectrum S ↦ q ≤ r) (Set.range p) → p.length = d
